svg.title: Sales Forecasting — source-derived reviewed benchmark chart
svg.desc: A chart derived from the repository's reviewed release benchmark for weekly median vehicle selling price. Mean fold RMSE: ARIMA one one one, 1764.63; ETS, 1783.29; last-value naive, 1891.95. Lower is better. There are only 32 observed weeks with two four-week holdout folds. This limited benchmark does not establish a universally best model. This is a source-derived chart, not a product screenshot.
svg.metadata: Source: https://github.com/AaryaMody1301/Sales-Forcasting-Using-Time-Series-Analysis/blob/main/README.md ; reviewed 2026-10-24. Arithmetic mean of two per-fold RMSE values; 24 initial training observations; 32 observed weekly values from 2014-12-21 to 2015-07-26. Original portfolio chart.

g.text: Let the baseline set the bar.
Weekly median vehicle selling price · lower error is better
A limited reproducibility benchmark; not a universally best-model claim.
